//: CORE ALONE: the strict typecheck of tsconfig.dag.json over core's sources with NO extension listed. The extension list's type comes from extensions.core.d.ts (generated from extensions.core.json: an empty tuple), so `Settings` has no extension keys and any core file that names an extension's dial, node or type fails here. Extensions and tests are left out (tests exercise the extensions); the core-alone TEST run is `npm run test:core`. Files are reached from the includes, so a core file importing an extension would pull it in and fail too. The app files are tsconfig.dag.json's React-free ones plus the core files that once named an extension (the store, the seeds, the library's class derivation and summary, the command paths); the React layer has no types to check (no @types/react, by design).
